identity.title: Control Center Streaming / Freshness / Gap / Resync Layer
identity.objective: Add a default-off request-scoped same-origin SSE transport that emits transport-only active-query-family refresh/resync signals with fixed cadence, connection-local sequence, gap/reconnect recovery and manual-refresh fallback while keeping every existing HTTP GET projection as the sole canonical data owner and adding no product network, credentials/account, command, paper mutation, execution, live or deployment authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-CC-STREAM-01. The stream module, streaming_enabled config/CLI flag, two /api/stream GET routes, centralized shell EventSource/controller/status indicator, shared disabled Storybook handler and stream contract/status/package disappear. Existing canonical domain stores, read models, dependencies, workflows, credentials, commands, deployment and live/economic state are not migrated or changed.
